target: AArch64 UTM-compatible QEMU, disposable VirtIO disk clone
command: QEMU=build/utm-qemu-probe/qemu-probe QEMU_VIRT='-L /Applications/UTM.app/Contents/Resources/qemu -machine virt,accel=hvf,gic-version=3 -cpu host -smp 1 -m 1024 -device virtio-ramfb -device virtio-keyboard-device -device virtio-tablet-device' ZEAL_COMPAT_LOG_PATH=build/check-stock-redsea-drive-api.log python3 -u scripts/check-compat.py --pci --probe-stock-redsea-file
result: pass: The stock RedSea fixture mounted as read-only D:. FilesFind found nested content through disk:/ and D:/, excluded source-only /System/InFile.ZC from both namespaces, and found LATE.ZC on the current drive. Drive('D') selected the mounted drive and reset cwd to /. Case-insensitive/relative lookups, empty-file semantics, source-store persistence across cold boot, compaction and zstatus failed=0 passed.
scope: This adds FilesFind and Drive selection for the one read-only RedSea fixture exposed as D: in the ARM guest. It does not provide writable RedSea, general device discovery/drive mounting, removable-media support, Pi storage update, or physical UTM/Pi acceptance.
